hook: Two trains on one railroad, two lines on one graph: set their starts, departure times and speeds, press Play, and watch where (and whether) they meet.
outcome: Solve a system of two linear equations by graphing and by setting the equations equal, and explain why a system has one solution, no solution or infinitely many using trains that meet, never meet or run together
sources: Common Core State Standards, Grade 8 Expressions and Equations, 8.EE.C.8: https://www.thecorestandards.org/Math/Content/8/EE/

OpenStax, Elementary Algebra 2e, 5.1 Solve Systems of Equations by Graphing: one, no and infinitely many solutions (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/books/elementary-algebra-2e/pages/5-1-solve-systems-of-equations-by-graphing

OpenStax, Elementary Algebra 2e, 3.5 Solve Uniform Motion Applications: distance equals rate times time (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/books/elementary-algebra-2e/pages/3-5-solve-uniform-motion-applications
